title: Jazzy Turkish Vermicelli Onigiri
description: Fresh, crisp Turkish vermicelli shaped into onigiri for a cozy, vegetarian bite. This playful fusion offers aromatic herbs and crunchy seeds for an aromatic finish.
instructions: Rinse the vermicelli under cold water until the water runs clear.
Heat a dry skillet over medium heat and toast the vermicelli until lightly golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Transfer the toasted vermicelli to a medium saucepan and add water, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until the vermicelli is tender and the liquid is absorbed, about 15 minutes.
Stir in parsley, lemon zest, dried mint, and sumac, then remove from heat and let the mixture cool slightly.
Shape the cooled vermicelli into small oblong rice balls using damp hands, forming the classic onigiri shape.
Roll each onigiri in toasted sesame seeds and crushed pistachios for extra texture and flavor.
Arrange the onigiri on a plate and serve immediately to enjoy their fresh crunch.
If desired, garnish with a light drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of fresh parsley before serving.
